Study Scholarships for Graduates of All Academic Disciplines

The DAAD Study Scholarship supports a full master's degree programme at a state or state-recognised German university. It is open to graduates of all academic disciplines who have completed a first degree no more than six years before applying, and who can demonstrate that the intended course of study in Germany is a coherent continuation of their academic and professional path.

Applicants may choose any state or state-recognised institution in Germany and any subject area. Programmes taught in English are eligible on the same terms as programmes taught in German, although candidates for German-taught programmes must document their language ability before the scholarship begins.

Application deadline

Application deadline: 1 October 2027. Applications close at 23:59 CEST on that date and the portal does not accept late submissions. Supporting documents uploaded after the closing date are not considered, and incomplete applications are rejected without review.

Value

Monthly payments of 992 euros for graduates, plus payments towards health, accident and personal liability insurance cover, a one-off study and research allowance, and a travel allowance where the scholarship holder does not receive one from another source.

Selection

Applications are assessed by an independent selection committee of academics in the relevant subject area. Academic quality carries the greatest weight, followed by the persuasiveness of the study plan and the candidate's reasons for choosing Germany.
